waivers.authorJustification: Data Connectors/AzureFunctionQualysVM_V2/function.json and Data Connectors/host.json are pre-existing Azure Function runtime configuration files co-located under Data Connectors/ rather than Sentinel connector UI definitions, while the actual Sentinel connector definition (Data Connectors/Template_QualysVulnerabilityManagement.json) has valid id/title/dataTypes/instructionSteps and is unchanged by this XDR migration.
